item.title: Easy Task For Arsenal As Man City Visit Crystal Palace And Wear-Tyne Derby Returns
item.description: Enzo Le Fee: English giants Arsenal have what looks to be their easiest game in a long time on Saturday when Mikel Arteta's Premier League leaders are at home to bottom-of-the-table Wolverhampton Wanderers.

item.title: Shadab Targets World Cup With A Good Bigbash Stint, Rues Ashwin Miss: Report
item.description: Twenty20 World Cup: Spin all-rounder Shadab Khan hopes a good season with the Sydney Thunder will help him regain his place in the Pakistan squad for the upcoming Twenty20 World Cup 2026, ruing a missed chance to play alongside Indian great Ravichandran Ashwin, says a report on Friday.

item.title: Chandidates 2026 Is A Strong Tournament Despite Absence Of Some Players: Praggnanandhaa
item.description: World Champion Dommaraju Gukesh: As we get ready to wind down 2025, India's World No. 7 chess Grandmaster Rameshbabu Praggnanandhaa has had a great season and is looking forward to the biggest event of the next season -- the Candidates 2026 event, which will select the challenger for World Champion Dommaraju Gukesh.

item.title: GOAT Tour Kicks Off As Lionel Messi Arrives In Kolkata
item.description: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Airport: The much awaited GOAT Tour India 2025 kicked off as Lionel Messi's arrived at Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Airport, Kolkata on Saturday.

item.title: Youth Asian Para Games: India Shines As Baby Sahana Ravi Wins Gold, Vishwa Vijay Tambe Secures Silver In Para Table Tennis
item.description: The Youth Asian Para Games: India’s para-athletes continued to make the nation proud, scoring remarkable victories that highlight their perseverance, spirit, and determination in the Youth Asian Para Games 2025 in Dubai.

item.title: I'm Still Determined To Play Three Formats As Best I Can, Says Hazlewood
item.description: T20 World Cup: Australia pacer Josh Hazlewood has no intention to back off from any format of cricket and will continue to play all forms despite missing the ongoing Ashes due to injury.

item.title: TPL 7: GS Delhi Aces Stay Firm At Top, SG Pipers Rise To Second After Day 4 (Ld)
item.description: Gujarat University Tennis Stadium: Gujarat Panthers were held to a draw by Gurgaon Grand Slammers; Chennai Smashers beat Hyderabad Strikers, GS Delhi Aces went down to SG Pipers while in the last match of the day, Yash Mumbai Eagles defeated Rajasthan Rangerson on the fourth day of Tennis Premier League (TPL) Season 7 at the Gujarat University Tennis Stadium in Ahmedabad on Friday.

item.title: India Need A Solid Foundation To Chase Big Score: Robin Uthappa
item.description: Follow The Blues: Former India batter Robin Uthappa provided a detailed assessment of the recently concluded second T20I at Mullanpur, praising South Africa’s all-round excellence whilst questioning India’s lack of clarity in batting roles during a big chase.

item.title: TPL Is Part Of A Dream To Expand And Popularise Tennis, Says Leander Paes
item.description: The GS Delhi Aces: Indian tennis icons Leander Paes and Mahesh Bhupathi expressed their excitement as they appeared together on day four of the Tennis Premier League.

item.title: Melbourne Renegades Sign Andrew Tye Ahead Of BBL 15
item.description: Renegades General Manager James Rosengarten: Melbourne Renegades on Saturday announced the signing of experienced campaigner Andrew Tye to bolster their bowling attack ahead of the season's opener.
